description: Tell this session what changed in the repository's Branchyard branches: a branch that finished, failed, is blocked or asks, or this branch's unread messages. Silent without by on PATH or outside a repository Branchyard uses.

hooks.command: command -v by >/dev/null 2>&1 && by hook session-start || true
command -v by >/dev/null 2>&1 && by hook user-prompt-submit || true
